about: Branch roles for the pull-request hygiene report (hygiene/build.py). Edit this file, not the code, when a release branch opens or fills. A base branch not named here is an 'other feature branch'.

role_notes.current: the release branch under development: new pull requests go here
role_notes.full: release branches that accept no new pull requests
role_notes.dead: an old release-candidate branch that will not be released again
role_notes.line: long-running development lines: weak-blocks (sub-blocks), v5.1.0 (6.1.x RocksDB pre-releases)
